cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(LMX_Storage_Extra LANGUAGES C)
    set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
    set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
    set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
    set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
    function(lmx_c99_target target)
        set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
        if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
            target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors)
        endif()
    endfunction()
    enable_testing()
    set(_storage_test_default ON)
else()
    set(_storage_test_default OFF)
endif()
if(NOT COMMAND lmx_c99_target)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "storage_extra requires lmx_c99_target")
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED LMX_VENDOR_DIR)
    get_filename_component(LMX_VENDOR_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../vendor" ABSOLUTE)
endif()
option(LMX_STORAGE_BUILD_TESTS "Build C99 storage roundtrip and persistence checks" ${_storage_test_default})
set(_storage_config "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config")
add_library(lmx_storage_extra INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::storage_extra ALIAS lmx_storage_extra)
function(lmx_storage_library name)
    add_library(lmx_storage_${name} STATIC ${ARGN})
    add_library(LMX::${name} ALIAS lmx_storage_${name})
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_storage_${name})
    target_link_libraries(lmx_storage_extra INTERFACE lmx_storage_${name})
endfunction()

set(_d "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/littlefs")
lmx_storage_library(littlefs "${_d}/lfs.c" "${_d}/lfs_util.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_storage_littlefs PUBLIC "${_d}")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_storage_littlefs PRIVATE LFS_NO_DEBUG LFS_NO_WARN LFS_NO_ERROR)

set(_d "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/heatshrink")
lmx_storage_library(heatshrink "${_d}/heatshrink_encoder.c" "${_d}/heatshrink_decoder.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_storage_heatshrink PUBLIC "${_d}")

set(_d "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/qcbor")
lmx_storage_library(qcbor "${_d}/src/qcbor_encode.c" "${_d}/src/qcbor_decode.c"
    "${_d}/src/qcbor_err_to_str.c" "${_d}/src/ieee754.c" "${_d}/src/UsefulBuf.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_storage_qcbor PUBLIC "${_d}/inc")
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_storage_qcbor PUBLIC m)
endif()

set(_d "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/tinycbor")
# Force the retained upstream software binary16 conversion: _Float16 is C23.
set(_tiny_source "${_d}/src")
set(_tiny_view "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/tinycbor_profile")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_tiny_view}/src")
file(GLOB _tiny_inputs "${_tiny_source}/*.c" "${_tiny_source}/*.h")
foreach(_f IN LISTS _tiny_inputs)
    get_filename_component(_name "${_f}" NAME)
    configure_file("${_f}" "${_tiny_view}/src/${_name}" COPYONLY)
endforeach()
file(SHA256 "${_tiny_source}/cborinternal_p.h" _tiny_sha)
if(NOT _tiny_sha STREQUAL "aedf9a9b0dd24e50a45cbfac8949c0226e674bcc8d6d3e877ac1599e87aa6660")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "TinyCBOR software binary16 source guard failed")
endif()
file(READ "${_tiny_source}/cborinternal_p.h" _tiny_h)
string(REPLACE "#  if (FLT16_MANT_DIG > 0 || __FLT16_MANT_DIG__ > 0) &&" "#  if 0 &&" _tiny_h "${_tiny_h}")
string(REPLACE "#  elif defined(__F16C__) || defined(__AVX2__)" "#  elif 0" _tiny_h "${_tiny_h}")
file(WRITE "${_tiny_view}/src/cborinternal_p.h" "${_tiny_h}")
file(SHA256 "${_tiny_source}/compilersupport_p.h" _tiny_sha)
if(NOT _tiny_sha STREQUAL "8cbe48d182d4e08ccfbcba507bbd927bb803f65367852b116d78a19bc165ad7b")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "TinyCBOR fallthrough source guard failed")
endif()
file(READ "${_tiny_source}/compilersupport_p.h" _tiny_support)
string(REPLACE "[[fallthrough]]" "do { } while (0)" _tiny_support "${_tiny_support}")
string(REPLACE "__attribute__((fallthrough))" "do { } while (0)" _tiny_support "${_tiny_support}")
file(WRITE "${_tiny_view}/src/compilersupport_p.h" "${_tiny_support}")
set(_d "${_tiny_view}")
lmx_storage_library(tinycbor "${_d}/src/cborencoder.c" "${_d}/src/cborencoder_close_container_checked.c"
    "${_d}/src/cborerrorstrings.c" "${_d}/src/cborparser.c" "${_d}/src/cborpretty.c"
    "${_d}/src/cborvalidation.c" "${_d}/src/cborparser_dup_string.c" "${_d}/src/cborpretty_stdio.c"
    "${_d}/src/cborencoder_float.c" "${_d}/src/cborparser_float.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_storage_tinycbor PUBLIC "${_d}/src" "${_storage_config}")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_storage_tinycbor PUBLIC CBOR_STATIC_DEFINE)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_storage_tinycbor PUBLIC m)
endif()

# ff.h includes a colocated ffconf.h, so isolate the selected profile in the build tree.
set(_d "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/fatfs/source")
set(_fatfs_view "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/fatfs_profile")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_fatfs_view}")
foreach(_f ff.c ff.h ffunicode.c ffsystem.c diskio.h)
    configure_file("${_d}/${_f}" "${_fatfs_view}/${_f}" COPYONLY)
endforeach()
configure_file("${_storage_config}/ffconf.h" "${_fatfs_view}/ffconf.h" COPYONLY)
lmx_storage_library(fatfs "${_fatfs_view}/ff.c" "${_fatfs_view}/ffunicode.c" "${_fatfs_view}/ffsystem.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_storage_fatfs PUBLIC "${_fatfs_view}")

set(_d "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/spiffs")
lmx_storage_library(spiffs "${_d}/src/spiffs_nucleus.c" "${_d}/src/spiffs_hydrogen.c"
    "${_d}/src/spiffs_cache.c" "${_d}/src/spiffs_gc.c" "${_d}/src/spiffs_check.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_storage_spiffs PUBLIC "${_d}/src" "${_storage_config}")

# Preserve upstream files. The two callback control commands need a portable
# pointer-to-callback object contract; see config/lmx_flashdb_callbacks.h.
set(_d "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/flashdb")
set(_flashdb_view "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/flashdb_profile")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_flashdb_view}")
set(_fdb_kvdb_sha 8d743dd379dcc817b935877644087bdbf4ce0d74ec3392a2618eea4620ef8d09)
set(_fdb_tsdb_sha 4cc8af0d53125bc3def23a9bfd9516545654fc517fd81fdf01da5a8521c64347)
foreach(_unit fdb_kvdb fdb_tsdb)
    file(SHA256 "${_d}/src/${_unit}.c" _actual_sha)
    if(NOT _actual_sha STREQUAL _${_unit}_sha)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "FlashDB source guard failed for ${_unit}.c")
    endif()
    file(READ "${_d}/src/${_unit}.c" _src)
    string(REPLACE "(void (*)(fdb_db_t db)) arg" "(arg ? *(void (**)(fdb_db_t))arg : NULL)" _src "${_src}")
    string(REPLACE "(void (*)(fdb_db_t db))arg" "(arg ? *(void (**)(fdb_db_t))arg : NULL)" _src "${_src}")
    string(REPLACE "#pragma GCC diagnostic push" "/* No non-C99 diagnostic suppression. */" _src "${_src}")
    string(REPLACE "#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored \"-Wpedantic\"" "" _src "${_src}")
    string(REPLACE "#pragma GCC diagnostic pop" "" _src "${_src}")
    file(WRITE "${_flashdb_view}/${_unit}.c" "${_src}")
endforeach()
lmx_storage_library(flashdb "${_d}/src/fdb.c" "${_d}/src/fdb_file.c" "${_d}/src/fdb_utils.c"
    "${_d}/src/fdb_read_cache.c" "${_flashdb_view}/fdb_kvdb.c" "${_flashdb_view}/fdb_tsdb.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_storage_flashdb PUBLIC "${_d}/inc" "${_storage_config}")

if(LMX_STORAGE_BUILD_TESTS)
    foreach(_case littlefs fatfs heatshrink spiffs flashdb cbor_interop)
        add_executable(lmx_storage_test_${_case} "tests/${_case}.c")
        lmx_c99_target(lmx_storage_test_${_case})
        if(_case STREQUAL "cbor_interop")
            target_link_libraries(lmx_storage_test_${_case} PRIVATE LMX::qcbor LMX::tinycbor)
        else()
            target_link_libraries(lmx_storage_test_${_case} PRIVATE LMX::${_case})
        endif()
        add_test(NAME storage_${_case} COMMAND lmx_storage_test_${_case})
        set_tests_properties(storage_${_case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
    endforeach()
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/flashdb_data")
    set_tests_properties(storage_flashdb PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/flashdb_data")
endif()
